cards.title: Hulk and clouds
cards.text: The Hulk is fast, commits to a direction, turns smoothly, and is always drawn. Clouds give off motes.
cards.why: Your round 8 notes. Mark any part that's off.
cards.details: Version 0.12.0. Close and reopen the app twice to get it. In Settings, Weapon has Shotgun and Rail.

parts.title: Hulk
parts.text: Faster than you (11 vs 8.5). Keeps a direction for 1 to 2.5 s, then turns toward you; turns at once if blocked. The turn swings over a little and settles. Seen through walls.

parts.title: Cloud motes
parts.text: Slow purple specks drift up out of gas clouds.

cards.title: Five new modules
cards.text: Pierce, Grow, Haste, Split and Knock, each on all three casts. They come in shards and level-ups.
cards.why: Stage 5, first batch, from the design list. Numbers are first guesses.

parts.title: Pierce
parts.text: Bolts pass through enemies. A ball rolls through them at full speed. A dash hits harder going through.

parts.title: Grow
parts.text: Bigger and stronger. A ball gets more health but is slower. A dash is wider and keeps you safe longer.

parts.title: Haste
parts.text: Faster bolts and reload; a ball thrown harder and back sooner; a dash longer and back sooner.

parts.title: Split
parts.text: A bolt forks in two when it hits or ends. A ball splits in two when it dies. A dash sends two echo dashes out at an angle.

parts.title: Knock
parts.text: Hits push enemies far. On a dash, its shoves become a shockwave.

cards.title: Shotgun and Rail
cards.text: Shotgun: 5 pellets, 2 shots then a reload. Rail: one slow, hard shot that goes through 4 enemies.
cards.why: More weapons, as you picked. Choose them in Settings for now.

parts.title: Shotgun
parts.text: Short range, 5 pellets fanned, 2 shots, then a full reload.

parts.title: Rail
parts.text: One round, 45 damage, very fast and long, through 4 enemies. Slow to come back.
